features.label: Irregular stellar body
features.description: Blue knots trace an uneven body with no clean spiral outline, while a central bar is still present.

explanation: IC 3583 shows that an irregular outline can contain internal organization and signs of gravitational disturbance.
colorMethod: Blue emphasizes bright young stellar populations in the processed Hubble image; it is not a clock for the whole galaxy.
whyItMatters: This reading separates what the image shows directly from what instruments, processing and context allow us to infer.
